issues.desc: The corrected background and CHK-003 now separate applicability from severity, but the signed scope-boundary still says all critical/high defects are repaired in this Story and its confirmation note still routes all major defects here without an applicability condition. This conflicts with the explicit exclusion against unrelated global-green work and could re-authorize unrelated high-severity expansion. Amend the controlling scope boundary so verified applicable critical/high defects require current repair, while verified non-applicable critical/high defects may leave only with strong current-gate nonblocking proof and a traceable owner/route.

CHK-004 is a justified current-Story repair because BUG-001 directly blocked B-212f verification evidence, and its user-visible outcome is bounded; however execution-boundary.json does not allow either packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts, packages/main/src/tasks/tool-executed-evidence-receipt-smoke.ts, or the npm test:tool-executed-evidence-receipt-smoke command. Reconcile the signed INIT execution boundary with the accepted CHK-004 scope before INIT_CHECK so the Story can deliver its declared outcome without acting outside its own authorization.
